sentences.en: When it got dark, the party organizer said: "Time to go".
sentences.zh: 天黑了，派对组织者说：‘该走了。’

sentences.en: As one of the organizers, I've been very busy.
sentences.zh: 作为其中一个组织者，我非常忙碌。

sentences.en: Organizers of the Coachella music festival moved the April event to October.
sentences.zh: 科切拉音乐节的组织者将四月的活动改到了十月。

senses.zh: 组织者，编制者，发起人,生形成体,〈口〉公文柜，（分类记事的）备忘记事簿,计整理器
